steps.content: Dense fog hangs in the air as grayish-white moonlight struggles to penetrate the mist, seeping through the dilapidated windows.
Mottled reflections from stained-glass windows paint the floor where a small figure stands utterly alone.
What is this place?
Looking forward or backward, the corridor seems to stretch endlessly in both directions.
The small figure wanders the corridor aimlessly, finding no doors or exits of any kind. Her mind fluctuates between lucidity and haziness.
Familiar voices emerge from the fog, seemingly coming from all directions at once. Mockery? Insults? Though the words are indistinct, she knows what they're saying all too well.
—She remembers this corridor.
<color=#fb9259>This place... I've been here before...</color>
Clank!
As if responding to her realization, a distant bell begins to toll.
The sound acts as a command or conditioned reflex, compelling her to involuntarily extend her hand to touch the fog before her...
The fog suddenly thickens, completely engulfing her.
As the white light fades away, the fog dissipates entirely.
As soon as she opens her eyes, she finds herself pushed to the ground by someone, with a half-eaten, shriveled piece of coarse bread lying on the floor beside her hand.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Hey! That was my half-eaten bread, you thief!
The two shadowy figures standing before her have indistinct features, as if intentionally blurred, revealing only dramatically oversized mouths that incessantly open and close.
I thought nobody wanted it... so I took it...

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: Taking things without permission is stealing!
Her stomach emits a low growl. Devoid of the strength to argue with the two older children who appear to be collaborating against her, she can only hope and silently pray they'll leave soon.
She shrinks further into the corner, her eyes fixed longingly on the piece of bread.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Ooooh! Not just a stray nobody wants—you're a thief too! No wonder your parents left you!
No... I'm not...
She begins to protest, but as her gaze falls upon her own reddened arms, panic sets in. Hastily, she retracts her arms, trying to hide the evidence of her secret.
But it's already too late—the older children have spotted her red skin and grow even bolder in their mockery.

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: Ewwww! Look at your gross red skin! Freak!

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: Still pretending you're not a monster? If you weren't one, why'd they throw you away?

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Yeah! When that old nun grabbed you, did she even know you were a freaky little monster?
Tears well up in the little monster's eyes as she desperately rubs her arms, but no matter how hard she scrubs, the red patches stubbornly stain her skin.
She wants to say she's not a monster, to deny she was left behind, but in this space, she finds herself unable to voice words she has never uttered before.
She is not like the others—that is truth. She was abandoned here—that, too, is truth.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: I'm sorry... I don't want it anymore. You can have it all... It must be because I'm not good enough... That's why no one wants me...
She covers her face. These words have echoed countless times before, and she believed she had grown numb to their sting, that they could no longer make her cry.
But these words still cut like sharp knives, slicing through her skin and shredding her clothes piece by piece.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Right, I... I've heard these words before. I...
<color=#fb9259>She has been here before, countless times</color>—strangely, this vague sensation surfaces within her.
Clank!
Once more, the bell tolls, shrouding her in dense fog... She drifts weightlessly, grasping at memories that vanish the moment they take shape...
Amidst jeers and mocking laughter, the little monster opens her eyes.
This is a wedding. She was just hiding herself in a corner of the hall, yearning to witness snippets of others' happiness, when the guests stumbled upon her.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: A wedding dress?! This little freak actually thinks she can wear a wedding dress like others?!

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: What's this filthy monster doing here? Come to ruin the ceremony?

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: I didn't mean to ruin anything... I just wanted to watch... Is that not allowed either?
Unfortunately, the little monster's plea and vulnerability elicit no empathy from the guests. Before she can finish speaking, more and more guests gather, instantly surrounding her.

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: She's a damn curse! Get her out of here before she snaps and hurts someone!

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Drive her away! Get her out!
A stone lands at her feet, quickly followed by a second, then a third. The crowd seems to have found their method of driving her away, as one by one they begin picking up stones from the ground.
The little monster stares blankly at the guests, watching the stones fly toward her with no thought of dodging.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: What's the point? Why bother dodging? This always happens... When has running ever helped?

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: No... <color=#fb9259>not even once</color>.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Then there's no need to struggle. Just accept it.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Mmph!
She closes her eyes, awaiting the inevitable pain about to come.
But the familiar pain from her memory never comes. With caution, she opens one eye.
She sees a pair of leather shoes planted firmly in front of her, while stones pelt that long gray coat instead.
She can't make out the person's face, yet feels a strange sense of familiarity.

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: It takes how many of you to pick on one? Must be so proud.
The figure casually tosses a stone up and down in their hand before hurling it at the child who has been shouting the loudest.

steps.speaker: Rowdy Child
steps.content: OW! Who the heck do you think you are?! You can't just peg rocks at my butt!

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: That's exactly why I did it.
The figure swiftly hurls several more stones, hitting the guests on their hands and legs, compelling them to retreat.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Th-that's impressive!
The little monster gazes at the gray-coated person before her, her eyes wide and shining with wonder.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: A-are you... an angel sent by heaven to save me? Are you my guardian angel?

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: ■■■, you can't just sit there and take their crap. You have to fight back.
The little monster, covered in dirt, is gently lifted to her feet, a warm hand enveloping her cold, tiny fingers. The person then picks up a stone and places it in her palm.
Mimicking her protector, she positions herself in a throwing stance.

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: Aim at your target, ready...
She anxiously tightens her grip. This nightmare has haunted her many times before, but this time, something is different.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: This time... can I break this nightmare?
However, the dreamscape appears to possess its own will. Before she can act, the familiar toll of the bell rings again...
CLANK... Thick fog appears once more, forcibly pulling her away.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: What's... happening?

The previous scene remains vivid in her mind as the little monster surveys her surroundings in bewilderment. Neither the figure in the gray coat nor the guests are within her view. Ahead of her lies the familiar corridor, enveloped in mist.
She is no longer the child from her memories—she now wears a wedding dress, her figure tall and slender.
Her tightly clenched hand trembles as she gradually unclasps it. The stone is now gone without a trace.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: I thought someone might finally love me...
She covers her face with her hands, letting the tears flow freely.
Voices from the fog converge as if gathering from all her nightmares, a persistent reminder—

steps.speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
steps.content: You don't deserve love. You don't deserve anyone to love you!

steps.speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
steps.content: A monster should stay where monsters belong, not crawling where humans walk!!

steps.speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
steps.content: That dream was just a mistake. How could anyone take it seriously? Don't be so foolish!

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: ...No, it was not a mistake...

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Bring it back, please bring it back...
The voices around her multiply, growing louder and more numerous. To escape them, she curls into a ball, hugging herself tightly.
Under the brainwashing pressure of these voices, her mind grows foggy once again, filling with thoughts that are not truly her own.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Yes... I'm just an ugly monster. How could I ever dream of a grand wedding or eternal love...

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Will anyone ever love me? Do I deserve to be loved?

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: Will that person from just now... ever come back?
She lifts her head in confusion, struggling to remember, yet the person's face remains just beyond her grasp.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: That person... who are they again?

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: And I... who am I?
The mist drifts like flowing vapor, transforming the moonlight into a delicate veil that drapes over her head.
Time thickens to syrup as she loses herself in thought. Then—amid the floating motes of dust—a single glint of light winks at her. Mesmerized, she reaches out in a daze.

steps.speaker: Little Monster
steps.content: A... ring? Wasn't it already...
Despite the obscuring mist, the ring on her finger still reflects a faint sliver of moonlight.
It's an ancient ring with elaborate patterns centered on a single staring eye. Though it's never appeared in her dreams before, she somehow knows it has already shattered and vanished in reality.

As this thought forms, the ring truly shatters, dissolving into specks of light that drift throughout the dreamscape. The bell that used to chime whenever she recalled something now remains eerily silent.
A multitude of dreams rush before her eyes, a myriad of grotesque faces intertwine with each other, and a cacophony of voices overlap, all beckoning her.
She remembers now...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I am not a "little monster." I am...<color=#fb9259>Graves</color>!
The moment she remembers her name, moonlight outside the window surges brilliantly, instantly dispersing the fog that has lingered here since time immemorial.
Finally, the corridor comes into focus. The voices that have persistently haunted her ears emanate from faceless shadows concealed along the corridor.
They emanate a cold, repulsive aura, trapping her in an endless cycle of past nightmares night after night.

steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: Did you forget? You're no longer alone.
A familiar voice resonates from behind her, as if it has traversed hundreds, thousands of dreams to reach her side.

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: Don't listen to those meaningless voices. You're not a monster—not even close.

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: You are beautiful, kind, and resilient. You deserve a wonderful wedding, and more than that, you deserve to be loved!

Graves doesn't dare lift her gaze to meet his, wary that the damned toll of the bell might reset everything back to the start. Fear tightens her heart, dreading that he might vanish again at any moment.
steps.female_content: Graves doesn't dare lift her gaze to meet hers, wary that the damned toll of the bell might reset everything back to the start. Fear tightens her heart, dreading that she might vanish again at any moment.

steps.content: Yet her fears fail to come true. Instead, one by one, figures exuding warmth start to materialize beside her.

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: Graves, you're amazing!

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: If it weren't for you, those Corruptors would've ended me!!

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: So what if you're a monster? You're an awesome monster who protects us!
More and more blurry figures with indistinct faces gather around Graves. Through their gestures, they convey to her, "We're on the same side."

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: Look, all these people acknowledge you. They need you.
The person in the gray coat reaches out a hand to her, just as before.

steps.speaker: Gray-Coated Person
steps.content: You should have thrown this stone long ago.
The stone she had been unable to throw somehow reappears in her palm. The warm hand withdraws, returning control of her body to Graves.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I can... throw it now!
Graves's voice grows increasingly determined. Under the watchful eyes of all the warm figures, she steps forward and throws the long-overdue stone at the dark shadows with indistinct faces.
Bang—
The scene before her shatters like glass. The grotesque faces crack and fall away, dissolving into weightless dream-dust. Then everything—including Graves herself—plummets rapidly downward.
Graves startles awake, sensing a coolness on her face. Raising her hand to her cheek, she finds it damp with tears.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Am I... crying?
She unfolds her palm to reveal faint traces of moisture. In her hand, she notices crescent-shaped marks, likely left by her nails from clenching her fist too tightly during her dream.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Strange. My face and hands feel cool, but deep down inside... something feels so warm.

Graves crosses her hands over her chest, trying to calm her racing heart after waking from the dream. That hollow place inside her seems to have been filled with something new—only warmth lingers now.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: This is... not my room...
The space before her isn't the vast, dilapidated castle, nor is it the stark room assigned to her by the Bureau. Instead, it's a simple room exuding a reassuring, homely atmosphere.
The lights are on here, as if intentionally left that way for someone who might wake at any moment.
Less than twenty centimeters away from Graves, at the bed's edge, rests a figure that she knows all too well.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: My dear?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See? No one is afraid of you. Nothing you worried about has happened, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like I said, you are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
As Graves hazily recalls the words she heard before losing consciousness, her cheeks grow warm.
She wraps herself in the blanket and inches closer to the figure beside her. Her long hair spills across the bedsheet and pillow, intertwining with the other person's.
She has no idea how long she's been unconscious, only certain that the person who has promised not to leave her is now faithfully staying by her side.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Hehe... waking up in a cozy room with my love lying beside me... I'm so happy...
Graves giggles with a silly grin. She feels pink bubbles fizzing in her heart as everything around her shimmers with a dreamlike glow that feels almost too wonderful to be real.
She props her cheek on one hand, lying on her side and gazing with a beaming smile at the person whose face was indistinct in her dream.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You're the one in my dream... <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: It must be you. That gray coat... I could never mistake it.
Not content with just looking, Graves reaches out with a single finger and begins to carefully trace the contours of that face.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Forehead, nose, eyes, lips... I'm memorizing it all. Next time you appear in my dreams, I'll definitely know it's you.
Her finger pauses on those soft lips, reluctant to move away.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Now... what are you dreaming about? Am I there too?
Thump-thump... thump-thump... only silence and the sound of her own heartbeat answer her question.
Graves gazes at the person, utterly mesmerized. The distance between them gradually closes until she can feel the slow, steady breath against her skin. Her own breathing quickens in response.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: There are no cameras watching us now, no staff, no other Sinners... just you and me...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: So... if I do something "naughty," no one would ever know, right?

Brushing the strands of hair away from her face, Graves closes her eyes and leans slowly toward those soft lips—approaching with the same devotion she had witnessed in countless kisses at the old castle.
The fleeting touch makes the person's eyelashes flutter, brushing against Graves. Her newly gathered courage bursts like a punctured balloon, instantly deflating.
Graves freezes in place, holding a push-up position for several seconds, terrified the person might open eyes and catch her in this compromising pose.
Fortunately, the person only furrows brow slightly before falling back into deep sleep.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Phew...
With the crisis now averted, Graves lets out a deep exhale. She meekly lies back down, wary of making any sudden movements.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Wh-what am I doing?! Ugh, so embarrassing...
It's well into the night, and the bed is comfortably warm. That tense little moment has even left Graves slightly sweaty.
Still, Graves nestles closer to the source of warmth, her shoulders touching the other person's as a gentle warmth passes between the two.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: It's odd... Whenever I'm near you, I always seem to have so much to say.
Her pounding heart is yet to calm down, and she is not ready to drift off to sleep.

Graves softly turns her head to the side, eliciting a response from the person beside her. ${PlayerName} shifts to the side, settling into a more comfortable posture. The arm furthest from Graves emerges from beneath the blanket and rests on her.
The gesture seems both like soothing a restless child who won't settle down to sleep, and like a gentle embrace.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Huh?
The courage she had just let slip away slowly begins to return. Graves turns onto her side as well, curling her body so they're now facing each other.
She takes her hand out from beneath the blanket and grasps the hand that has so conveniently presented itself.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: My dear, do you know? Since coming here, I think I've become greedy... wanting more than just a wedding...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Going on missions, helping with logistics, I'd do anything! We could cook a meal together, or plant a tree... Anything as long as I'm with you.
As Graves carefully lists all the things she wants to do together, she slowly slides her hand into the one larger than hers.
steps.female_content: As Graves carefully lists all the things she wants to do together, she slowly slides her hand into the one slightly larger than hers.

steps.content: She gently spreads those fingers one by one, then interlocks them with her own until their hands are tightly clasped together.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Yes... this is how it should be. This is... how close we belong.
With a look of contentment, Graves holds their interlaced fingers against her chest, like a maiden deep in prayer.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Let me think, what else could we do together... hmm... I can't think of any more!
The emptiness in Graves's heart is gradually being filled—not just with warmth and love from others, but also with her own newfound dreams of future happiness.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Thank you for teaching me all this. Thank you for saving my dreams.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: As long as I stay by your side, these wishes will all come true, right...
As she continues speaking, her soliloquies about the future gradually melt into gentle whispers, scattering throughout the room.
Graves's eyelashes flutter gently as a sweet smile plays on her lips. This time, her dreams are bound to be beautiful ones.

In her dreams, gone are the impenetrable fog and haunting whispers. In their place is a lover who cherishes her with tenderness and friends who accept her for who she truly is. Together, they stand guard, allowing her to slumber peacefully in sweet dreams.
Night falls over the Bureau, its corridors silent and still. Suddenly, a soft blue light emerges from one of the walls.
Following the light, a young girl materializes, strolling through the corridor without making a sound. As she passes by one of the rooms, she sniffs the air before coming to a sudden stop.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh well... someone got a bit too excited for their midnight Bureau adventure. Even so, you should still remember to close the door, pretty lady.
She steps forward carefully and gives the door a gentle pull—the lock clicks into place with a crisp snap.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So many careless people these days. Good thing yours truly—the nighttime guardian of the Bureau—Letta is on duty! Heehee.
As another good deed is accomplished, the lantern in her hand seems to radiate a little brighter in response. Content with her actions, Letta moves forward, resuming her nighttime adventure.
